one_liner: Watchlist civic-letter workflow; prove identity, demand, local coverage, and delivery before pitching.
directive: Upgrade the project soul to VC-grade diligence while preserving workspace truth and marking all external claims as assumptions.

sources: package.json [evidence: repo product name and scripts]
methods: Read existing planning corpus and code paths.
Separated repo-observed implementation from planned or external market claims.
Built bottom-up sizing from current pricing tiers and campaign-count assumptions.
Tagged repo facts as evidence and external claims as assumptions.
research.freshness: Reviewed on 2026-06-23 [evidence: dispatch current_date]; no external freshness check because network was unavailable.

planningMethod.marketSizing: Bottom-up from campaign count x average price; no top-down market claim.
planningMethod.financialModel: Revenue build reconciles campaigns/month x price x months to annual revenue.
planningMethod.riskReview: Anti-plan written from a skeptical partner view: identity mismatch, tiny market, local data stub, compliance, deliverability, weak moat.

customer.primary: US residents with specific civic concerns who want researched constituent letters [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].
customer.excluded: Legal advice, claim filing, regulatory filings, harassment, bulk spam, lobbying-firm workflows [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md; MASTER_PLAN.md].
customer.validationNeeded: No workspace evidence of paid users or traffic as of 2026-06-23 [evidence: current repo state].

market.som: 100 paid campaigns/month x $15 x 12 months = $18,000 annual [assumption: conservative beachhead using current midpoint price].
market.sam: 10,000 paid campaigns/year x $15 = $150,000 annual [assumption: SEO-reachable niche unvalidated].
market.tam: 100,000 paid campaigns/year x $15 = $1,500,000 annual [assumption: bounded research TAM, not total civic-tech spend].

businessModel.unitEconomics: $1.20 COGS on a $15 package and 92% gross margin are planning estimates, not observed performance [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md section 19.1].

revenueAssumptions: Validation year: 50 campaigns/month x $15 x 12 months = $9,000 [assumption: beta revenue build].
Early SEO year: 150 campaigns/month x $16 x 12 months = $28,800 [assumption: unvalidated SEO lift].
Operating year: 400 campaigns/month x $18 x 12 months = $86,400 [assumption: modeled scale case].
costAssumptions: Variable cost plus processor fees modeled at 12% of revenue [assumption: combines MASTER_PLAN.md 8% variable COGS and 4% Stripe fee planning estimates].
Fixed platform cost starts at $200/month [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md section 19.3].
Operator cost added at $30,000 in operating year [assumption: part-time review/support model].
sensitivityTests: If conversion is 1% instead of 3%, pause business pitch [assumption: demand downside].
If deliverability is below 85%, pause paid sending [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].
If local coverage remains 0 from the Cicero stub, constrain launch scope [evidence: apps/api/src/lib/officials/cicero.ts].

alternatives: Manual Google search plus email [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md describes replaced steps].
Resistbot [assumption: model-memory competitor characterization, no network verification].
Quorum and VoterVoice [assumption: model-memory enterprise alternatives, no network verification].
Legal services for legal-adjacent needs [assumption: substitute category; no network verification].

holes: Identity mismatch between dispatch project `brooks-history` and repo product CivicState [evidence: dispatch project id; package.json].
Local officials are not implemented; Cicero returns empty arrays without future integration [evidence: apps/api/src/lib/officials/cicero.ts].
No workspace proof of paid demand, live revenue, or production deliverability [evidence: current repo state].
Moat is volume-dependent and weak before meaningful campaigns [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md].
mitigations: Get operator ruling before wrk.vc pitch.
Run controlled paid beta before SEO scale.
Replace or scope around local-official provider gap.
Keep all external market claims as assumptions until network research is allowed.
residualRisks: Consumer willingness to pay may be too low.
Compliance or platform enforcement may interrupt payments or delivery.
Competitors or substitutes can copy the low-volume workflow.

strategy.posture: Watchlist research asset until validation gates clear [evidence: dispatch registry notes].
strategy.wedge: One metro, narrow issue categories, manual cohort recruitment [assumption: launch containment].
strategy.moatPath: Operational quality plus accumulated official/citation/response data after volume [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md].

goToMarket.firstCustomers: First 25 paid campaigns from manual local recruitment [assumption: controlled beta].
goToMarket.firstScale: First 100 campaigns from opt-in public pages and issue-specific content [assumption: SEO/social hypothesis from .planning/GENESIS.md].
channels: Manual local outreach [assumption: no channel evidence]

operatorWorkflow.routine: Exception-based review of flagged submissions, delivery failures, bounced officials, and treasury alerts [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md; apps/api/src/routes/admin.ts].
requiredRulings: Confirm whether to pitch as a business.

constraints: Workspace-only research; no external verification [evidence: dispatch brief].
Registry watchlist/personal research sensitivity [evidence: dispatch registry notes].
No legal/regulatory conclusions invented [evidence: dispatch brief].
Current implementation uses Clerk and Stripe directly, creating WrkPlug posture conflict [evidence: apps/api/src/middleware/auth.ts; apps/api/src/routes/payments.ts].
metrics: Zero sent letters with fabricated citations [assumption: quality gate].
Spam complaint and opt-out events tracked per delivery [evidence: apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts; apps/worker/src/agents/delivery.ts].

rules: Moderation blocks threats and flags risky claims [evidence: apps/api/src/lib/moderation.ts].
Agent actions and token usage logged [evidence: apps/worker/src/lib/logger.ts; .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md].

unknowns: Whether `brooks-history` is a registry error or intended wrapper for CivicState.
Whether users will pay after preview.
Whether local official data can be covered economically.
Whether government inbox delivery is reliable.
Whether WrkPlug shared rails must replace Clerk and Stripe.
